description: Stadtentwicklungsplan (StEP) Wirtschaft 2040 is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GDI-DE. Stadtentwicklungsplan (StEP) Wirtschaft 2040: Der StEP Wirtschaft 2040 stellt auf gesamtstädtischer Ebene den planerischen Rahmen für die in den nächsten Jahren nötige Gewerbeflächensicherung und -entwicklung dar: Er schafft erstens die planerischen Voraussetzungen, um gewerbliche Flächen zu sichern. Coverage: GDI-DE. The portal files it under the publisher GDI-DE. Its tags are 2040, aktivierung, berlin, büro, entwicklungskonzept. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-07-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
